rulesTestNames: lets an account read only its own access view
lists an account's own views by a query naming its uid, and no others
owner: Programme access writers: programAuthorityWrites (in each grant command's transaction) and the organizer trigger programAccessViewTriggers
read: an account gets only its own view by the derived id programId__uid, and lists only its own views by a query naming its uid, while it is not deleted. Released Host builds gate the work shell and the programme list on it; no security rule authorises through it any more
write: server only; written in the transaction of the command that creates the programme or issues, claims or revokes a staff grant, and by a trigger on organizers for the organizer manager flag. Released Host builds read it; rules no longer authorise through it (accessGrants does)
migrationNotes: Mirrors requireProgramAccess without the clock: expiries, the grant expiry and the owner's authorization deadline are folded into per-duty instants that rules compare with request.time. The program-access-views copy-forward migration creates views for owners and grants that predate the triggers.

organizerManager mirrors requireProgramSetupAccess's organizer-manager branch for the phone's offline gate on the programme list and detail; it grants no duty, so an organizer manager's setup-only view is inactive. The program-access-views-organizer-managers migration creates views for organizer managers and adds the flag to existing views.

The view holds ids, duty names and instants only, never the grant's name or phone digits, so account deletion and archive anonymization have no personal data to scrub in it; it keeps the uid the grant keeps.

Issue #2474 step 1: grant, revoke, claim and programme creation write the view in their own transaction beside its accessGrants document, so onProgramAccessViewGrantChanged and onProgramAccessViewProgramChanged are retired. The organizer trigger stays for the organizer manager flag, which is display only, until step 3.
